detail.longDescription: So, the new Popover API in # HTML is pretty cool, except for one…rather serious problem: # CSS `position:static` can't be applied to a popover element! That's a Problem™ because, if you want to *print* the page including popover content, well, you can't. The popover will still pop over, even in print where you can't scroll around it! (Swiping on a piece of paper doesn't do anything except maybe hurt your finger.) So…that's annoying. # webdev
